Identical observations gave batch2 versus batch1 native float32 action differences of 2.38e-7, amplified by feedback to 0.01839038 return difference. numerical_amendment.policy: Every actor call uses unchanged native inference on exactly one float32 observation. This contract applies to candidate generation, forced-action continuation, scalar replay, and policy-action Q=V. No JIT, precision or parameter change. This fixes a different numerical deployment from V1's batch-dependent policy; no bitwise equivalence claim.

status: source prepared; no execution or outcome inspection yet; run requires separately reviewed freeze.json

evaluation.state_law: independent U[-.5,.5]^10; current .3/1.1; wave amplitude .2 uniform phase; balanced four contexts; designed query law, not occupancy
evaluation.candidate_order: six distinct categorical grid commands: projected actor, behavior mode if distinct, independent uniform grid IDs until six; then original actor and five independent uniform [-1,1]^4 commands; all deployed as float32
evaluation.support: actual float32 equality to the five categorical atoms in every coordinate, not candidate slot; common beta>=.01, rare 0<beta<.01, unsupported beta=0; conditional action support does not establish joint state/calibration support

adaptation.coefficient: RMS(U minus within-state mean U)/RMS(D minus within-state mean D), pooled equally over adaptation states/candidates; matches score dispersion, not gradient strength; no truth returns used; unavailable if any unusable U or zero/nonfinite denominator; no retuning
adaptation.D: mean over action coordinates of (candidate minus behavior mode)^2

scores.raw_q: current critic head Q1 (index0), not twin minimum
scores.live_width: Q1-U, kappa=1; U is native frozen_level_dose(reference,eta,.5).width verified against R*unit*max(eta,1e-6)
scores.constant_offset: Q1 minus within-state mean of usable U (0 if none); ranking control
scores.detached_width: identical forward Q1-U values; no gradient or actor optimization in this diagnostic
scores.width_refusal: candidate-wise nonfinite/unusable width falls back to raw Q1 with explicit refusal flag; this is a proposed score fallback, not the native BC intervention rule
scores.ties: argmax uses first exact maximum in fixed candidate order, including duplicated actor/grid commands; pairwise absolute differences<=1e-6 are near-ties, truth near-ties excluded, predicted near-ties count one-half; Spearman uses exact average ranks, undefined constant ranks recorded as null

truth.definition: candidate action once, then original frozen deterministic actor with canonical single-row inference to H=100, gamma=1, no terminal bootstrap; no Qstar or target-critic approximation
truth.deployment: float32 observations/actions with clipping [-1,1]; exactly one observation per native actor inference; actual float64 continuous.dynamics
truth.fixtures: four fixed states/times(0,50,99,99), batch/scalar forced Q and batch policy-action Q/scalar V; at most608 transitions
truth.label_uncertainty: deterministic numerical replay; no Monte Carlo Q-label uncertainty; same single-row actor inference on all paths, fixed replay checks retained

inference.bootstrap: paired state resampling within context x time strata; full bank preserves predeclared3/3/2 mixture, support subgroups preserve observed eligible context-time counts and do not invent missing strata; all candidates at a state kept together; percentile95 intervals; support subgroup requires at least2 eligible actions per state; CI unavailable if any nonempty eligible stratum has fewer than2 states
inference.tiny_strata: 2-3 states per context-time stratum,32 total; subgroup counts explicitly reported
inference.scope: conditional designed-state-law uncertainty for one fixed trained model and one frozen coefficient; not across-training-seed evidence or Q coverage

execution.prepare: save all raw inputs, score readouts, coefficient and hashes before truth labels
execution.run: exclusive new output directory; require explicit reviewed freeze binding protocol/code/input hashes; no resume or overwriting partial output

limitations: Fresh states are new physical arrays from independent RNG streams, not reused or selected historical source rows.
Critic was trained with smoothed target actor updates; Qpi oracle follows actual unsmoothed actor.

Frozen95k reference calibrated a one-step residual using min(current twin critics) against a noisy target-network target; the proposed score usesQ1. Numeric width export certifies neitherQ1 nor long-return error.

The historical128-row pooled bank was reused adaptively. Designed reset-law states at times0/50/99 and mixed grid/continuous actions differ from that bank. Conditional action-grid support is not joint state/calibration support.
Candidate ranking is a one-action deviation followed by original actor; it is not evaluation of a newly controlled multistep policy.
No action optimization, actor update, checkpoint selection, density-ratio correction, remote host access, or upload.
